title: Earth Observation Foundation Models for Terrestrial Ecohydrology: From Representation Learning to Process Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.15282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Earth observation foundation models (EOFMs) are emerging as reusable representation frameworks for data-driven retrieval, prediction and process modelling within ecohydrology, which integrate EO, meteorological forcing and process models to characterise coupled water, energy and carbon dynamics in vegetation and soil across scales. However, there is yet to be an ecohydrology-specific synthesis assessing the EOFM relevance, application evidence or evaluation requirements under uncertain reference data, scale mismatch and temporal dependence. Here, we develop a framework for determining when EOFMs support interpretable inference and identify a mismatch between EOFMs and ecohydrological requirements. Firstly, an observation-to-inference hierarchy shows that relevance depends on target-specific sensing pathways, spatial-temporal support and traceable uncertainty. translated_title: 地球观测基础模型用于陆地生态水文学：从表示学习到过程推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15282v1 公告类型：新 摘要：地球观测基础模型（EOFMs）正成为生态水文学中数据驱动检索、预测和过程建模的可重用表示框架，它们整合了地球观测、气象强迫和过程模型，以表征跨尺度的植被和土壤中耦合的水、能量和碳动态。然而，目前尚缺乏针对生态水文学的专门综合评估，以在参考数据不确定、尺度不匹配和时间依赖的情况下，评估EOFMs的相关性、应用证据或评估要求。在此，我们开发了一个框架，用于确定EOFMs何时支持可解释推断，并识别出EOFMs与生态水文需求之间的不匹配。首先，一个从观测到推断的层级表明，相关性取决于目标特定的传感路径、时空支持和可追溯的不确定性。其次，一项元分析显示，预训练主要受反射光学数据主导。
tldr: 本文提出一个框架，用于评估地球观测基础模型在生态水文学中的适用性，并揭示其与生态水文需求在可解释推断和数据处理上的关键不匹配。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework to assess the applicability of Earth observation foundation models in ecohydrology, revealing a key mismatch with ecohydrological needs in interpretable inference and data processing.
